first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: In frame 0 of this clip, Person A's head and shoulders are in the foreground at the lower left of the image. The person has short dark hair and wears a blue-gray top with rolled-up sleeves, brown pants, and brown crossed shoulder straps; tracked by clothing and continuous action, with position potentially changing with the camera.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The other person who continuously interacts with Person A in this clip. The person has relatively short gray-brown hair and wears a dark crew-neck short-sleeved top and dark pants; the person does not have Person A's crossed shoulder straps and continuously interacts with Person A while holding a sword.

entities.name: Sword A
entities.identification: The sword held by Person A, identified by its held relationship with Person A and continuous action; a long curved blade and a metal guard near the hand are visible.

entities.name: Sword B
entities.identification: The sword held by Person B, identified by its held relationship with Person B and continuous action; its designation does not change based on being at the top or bottom of the image or on momentary reflections.

entities.name: Wooden Plank Floor
entities.identification: The continuous wooden plank surface beneath the people's feet and between the two people, with seams between the planks extending into the distance; it does not include the stairs above, the Pillar, or the scattered metal objects.

entities.name: Metal Debris on the Ground
entities.identification: The collection of disc-shaped and irregular small metal objects scattered and piled on the Wooden Plank Floor; the objects are not numbered individually, and Sparks from Clashing Swords in the air are not included.

entities.name: Pillar
entities.identification: The thick upright columnar structural component indoors, visible at the side and in the background; it is defined separately from the slender rods of the Grating.

entities.name: Background Wall Rack
entities.identification: The background structure composed of the large dark wall surface, frame edges, and elevated beam rack behind the people, excluding the separately defined Pillar, Grating, Background Stairs, and Box.

entities.name: Grating
entities.identification: The Grating in the background or beside the people, composed of repeated vertical rods and connecting horizontal rods, including its thicker edge rods; limited to the range currently visible in this clip.

entities.name: Flames
entities.identification: The orange-yellow tongues of fire visible near the Pillar, Background Wall Rack, and edges of the background; this does not include the white flashes and brief sparks that appear when the swords clash.
